<assessment>SOURCE is one street-level oblique view: a tall right-hand tower steps down toward a connected low wing and left block. Visible features include pale projecting grids, recessed glazing and scattered outdoor bays, planted setbacks, flat roof edges, a darker lower facade zone and glazed ground-floor frontage. CURRENT 10–12 retain this overall arrangement and show improved tower recesses with visible side returns, soffits and inset glazing. The remaining clear mismatch is the charcoal outer framing across the left block and connector. Concealed slab-wall contacts and railing fixings remain unverified; unseen rear elevations cannot establish source fidelity. SOURCE also contains neighboring buildings and street context now absent from CURRENT. Recorded removal intent conflicts with the active neighbor requirement; the invalid host scope does not settle that conflict, so restoration is not prescribed.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="front">problem: CURRENT 10 and 12 show broad charcoal outer beams and columns across the left block and connector. SOURCE maintains pale projecting members around darker recessed facade components, so the current band obscures the continuous pale grid.
action: Locally correct the affected outward-facing grid members to the source’s pale finish. Retain the darker recessed lower facade zone, existing bay divisions, completed tower recesses and connected terrace geometry.</issue>
<keep>Tower recesses’ visible side returns, soffits and inset glazing.
Connected planted setback terraces above the low wing.
Aligned floor and bay divisions in the pale upper tower grid.</keep>
